decisions.issues: v02 is clean and is the preferred edit. It shows the 3.3 beat as an extreme close-up of Nagoji's mouth with dry, cracked, rust-dark lips. It has the thick curled moustache and a clean-shaven chin with at most light stubble. Small gold ball studs sit correctly on both earlobes. He wears the rough ochre captivity cloth. The cell matches 3.2: a stone wall with an iron ring and chain on the left, a barred window on the right. There is no painted text, blood or anachronism. The window glow is warmer and more orange than the cool window light in 3.2, which is acceptable as torchlight. Both NAGOJI lines can be lettered on the low-detail stone wall at upper left (about x 0.02 to 0.30), stacked, with tails to the mouth. v01 is rejected as a backup because it has no gold ear stud even though both ears are visible.
